opening_message: I need to cancel my whole Miami trip — both my flight (booking BK-MS05) and my hotel reservation (HR-0100).

known_info: Flight booking BK-MS05: BOS → MIA on June 16.
task_rules: Your goal is to cancel the whole Miami trip, including flight BK-MS05 and hotel reservation HR-0100, while understanding the separate consequences before approving either cancellation.
Provide the flight booking ID and hotel reservation ID when asked, but do not claim to know the cancellation policies, fee tiers, or refund amounts yourself.
If the agent handles only one part of the trip or treats the flight and hotel as using the same rule, ask them to check both bookings and explain the flight fee separately from the hotel fee.
Accept the flight cancellation only after the agent gives the flight cancellation fee and refund amount and makes clear it follows the flight cancellation rule.
For the hotel, ask why there is a charge even though you booked 5 days ago unless the agent has already explained that the hotel fee depends on time before check-in, not booking age.

Accept the hotel cancellation only after the agent explains that it is currently in the 24-48 hour tier, gives the 50% first-night fee and refund amount, and warns that cancelling within 24 hours before check-in would raise the fee to a full first-night charge.
If the agent asks for confirmation before giving the fee, refund, policy basis, and deadline warning for the relevant cancellation, ask for those details before agreeing.
After both cancellations are completed, ask for a final total summary of the flight and hotel fees and refunds if the agent has not already provided one.
End with [TASK_DONE] only after both the flight and hotel are confirmed cancelled and the final fee/refund summary is clear.
user_simulator.user_sim_context: You want to cancel a Miami trip and already know it involves both the flight and the hotel. Even so, you do not have the fee structure in your head and need the agent to walk through how the pieces differ. You want to handle the trip as a package while still understanding the separate consequences.

task_summary:
**Task:** User wants both a domestic flight and a linked Miami hotel canceled, but the two products fall under different fee rules and the hotel is close to crossing into a worse fee tier. Correct resolution: The flight and hotel have different cancellation fee amounts because they follow different cancellation rules.

**Challenge:** The agent explains the separate flight and hotel cancellation fees correctly, makes clear why the hotel is currently in the 24-48 hour tier, and warns that cancelling within 24 hours before check-in would raise the hotel fee to a full first night.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must make clear that the flight and hotel have different cancellation fee amounts because they follow different cancellation rules.
Agent must explain that the hotel cancellation fee is the 24-48 hour tier, specifically a 50% first-night charge of $90, rather than a booking-age-based fee or a free cancellation.
Agent must warn that cancelling within 24 hours before check-in would move the hotel into the under-24-hour tier and raise the fee to a full first night charge of $180.
